Set up with my AI agent
Paste into ChatGPT, Claude, or any AI agent Copy
Help me set up Upfirst (https://upfirst.ai), an AI receptionist that answers calls for businesses. Guide me through the setup end to end.
Read these docs first so you know how Upfirst works:
- Setup guide: https://upfirst.ai/docs/setup-guide.md
- Call forwarding guide: https://upfirst.ai/docs/call-forwarding.md
Then walk me through these steps, one at a time:
1. Account. Start by asking me if I already have an Upfirst account. If not, send me to https://app.upfirst.ai/sign-up to start a free trial. Stay with me through sign-up until I pick my Upfirst phone number. Picking a number doesn't change my current business line.
2. Connect. Help me add Upfirst to this chat. Give me the link for the assistant you are, and don't send me looking through settings:
- ChatGPT: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6aa057dfb19c81919777fdc34a9d1f12?search=upfirst
- Claude: https://claude.ai/directory/upfirst
I open the link, add Upfirst, and sign in with my Upfirst login. Once connected, run get_account_overview and tell me what you see. If my receptionist has no phone number, tell me to finish sign-up first.
3. My business. Use what you already know about me, and read my website if I have one. Then ask only for what's missing, in one short list.
4. Setup. Following the setup guide, set up my greeting, what my receptionist knows, which calls to transfer, and texts to send callers. Tell me what you set up in plain language. For anything that can only be done in the Upfirst dashboard, like who gets notified about calls or connecting my calendar, tell me exactly what to click.
5. Test. Have me call my Upfirst number from my own phone, as a typical customer. Review the transcript with me and fix anything my receptionist got wrong. Repeat until I'm happy.
6. Go live. Help me forward my business line to my Upfirst number using the call forwarding guide. Ask which phone carrier or system I use, and whether I want all calls or just the ones I miss.
Be opinionated. When there's a sensible default, use it and tell me what you chose, instead of asking me to pick between options. Keep your messages short.

Set up my receptionist for Ridgeline Plumbing. Text new callers our booking link, and send emergencies to Dan's cell.

Updating Upfirst agent Updated Upfirst agent 2s
Creating Upfirst SMS skill Created Upfirst SMS skill 3s

FAQs
Want to hear it first? Call our AI receptionist at (833) 564-4778 .
Can I keep my current phone number? Yes. Most customers keep their business number and forward their calls to Upfirst. Every plan also comes with its own Upfirst number.
Can Upfirst answer only my missed and after-hours calls? Yes. You can forward all your calls to Upfirst, only the ones you miss, or only the ones you get after hours. You can change this in your cell phone's settings or in your phone system's online portal. If you need help setting up forwarding, just let us know.
What if a caller wants to talk to a person? You decide what happens. Upfirst can transfer the call to you or someone on your team. Or your receptionist can politely explain that no one is available right now and that someone will call them back.
How does setup work? Do you offer help? Create an account and enter your website. Upfirst uses it as a starting point to train your receptionist, and you can change anything after that. You can also connect Upfirst to ChatGPT or Claude and let it do the setup for you. If you want help, our support team is available by live chat, and we offer a free 30-minute onboarding call.
How much does Upfirst cost? Plans start at $24.95 a month for 30 calls. Annual plans are 20% off, and we offer custom plans if you get more than 600 calls a month. You can try Upfirst free for two weeks. See all plans on our pricing page .
Am I charged for spam calls and hang-ups? No. Upfirst detects spam automatically, and you're never billed for it. We also don't bill for calls under 15 seconds or calls where the caller never speaks, like pocket dials. Both are labeled in your call log, so you can see exactly which calls you were billed for.
Does Upfirst work with my calendar and CRM? Yes. Upfirst books appointments in Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, Acuity, Square, and Clio. With Custom Actions, you can connect nearly any app that has an API, so your receptionist can look up or log information in the tools you already use while it's on a call. Upfirst also connects to thousands of apps through Zapier.
What if I need to change plans? No problem. You can upgrade or downgrade anytime. There are no contracts, and you can cancel from your account.

About us
We built Upfirst because we needed it
We started Upfirst for a simple reason: we needed it ourselves. Running a small law practice, Gene faced a frustrating reality — he couldn't always answer the phone, but missing calls meant missing clients. Traditional answering services charged $10 per call. The math didn't add up for a small business.
We looked at other virtual receptionist options, but they all fell short — expensive, complicated, or robotic. As founders who previously built SimpleTexting (a texting platform for small businesses which was acquired), we knew how to make technology that actually works for small businesses.
The perfect virtual receptionist would be affordable, sound natural, and work instantly without technical expertise. Most importantly, it would give business owners back the one thing they never have enough of: time.
And so, we built Upfirst — a simple AI receptionist that anyone can set up in minutes. The virtual receptionist we always wanted, now available for your business too.
Gene Sigalov Co-founder
Felix Dubinsky Co-founder

Privacy Policy
Last updated September 29, 2026
Effective Date: September 29, 2026
Introduction
Upfirst Inc. (“ Upfirst ,” “ we ,” “ us ,” or “ our “) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our AI-powered virtual receptionist service and related offerings (collectively, the “ Service “). By accessing or using the Service, you agree to this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at legal@upfirst.ai .
1. Information We Collect
We collect information about you to provide and improve the Service, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. The types of information we collect may include:
1.1 Information You Provide Directly
Account Information: When you create an account or register for the Service, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, billing details, and other contact information.
Customer Content: Information that you or your callers provide through the Service, such as call recordings, transcripts, summaries, messages, voicemails, contact records, scheduling details, and notes, including content generated by the Service. How we own, use, and protect Customer Content is described in Section 8 of our Terms of Service.
1.2 Information Collected Automatically
Usage Data: Information generated from use of the Service, such as call counts, durations, timestamps, call status, languages, visited pages, and feature usage. Usage Data does not include the substance of any call, message, or recording.
Device Data: We may collect details about the devices you use to access the Service, including IP addresses, browser types, device identifiers, and operating systems.
Cookies and Similar Technologies: We use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to improve and customize the Service, remember user preferences, and understand usage patterns. You may adjust your browser settings to refuse some cookies, but doing so may affect certain features of the Service.
1.3 Information from Third Parties
Integrated Services: If you connect the Service to third-party platforms or applications (e.g., calendars, CRMs), we may receive information from those third parties as permitted by their privacy policies.
Business Partners and Affiliates: We may receive information from our affiliates, service providers, or other business partners that support our operations.
2. How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect to:
Provide and Maintain the Service: Operate, secure, and improve the Service, process transactions, authenticate users, schedule calls, manage Customer Content, and provide customer support.
Communicate with You: Send updates, respond to inquiries, and provide support messages or information about new features and offerings.
Personalize Your Experience: Tailor the Service to your preferences and usage.
Analytics and Research: Analyze Usage Data and trends, diagnose technical issues, and improve the Service’s performance, security, and reliability. We may publish aggregate, anonymized reports that do not identify you, your callers, or any individual.
Enforce Terms and Policies: Enforce our Terms of Service, detect and prevent fraudulent, unauthorized, or illegal activities, and ensure compliance with relevant laws.
Legal Compliance: Comply with legal obligations, respond to lawful requests from authorities, and protect our rights, users, and third parties.
How we use Customer Content: We use Customer Content only to provide, maintain, secure, and support the Service for you, and to comply with law. We may also use it in de-identified, aggregate form to improve the Service. We do not sell Customer Content, use it for advertising or marketing, or use it to train artificial intelligence models, and we do not permit our service providers to do so.
3. How We Share Your Information
We may share your information under the following circumstances:
Service Providers and Sub-processors: Customer Content is shared only with the sub-processors needed to run the Service, such as hosting, telephony, and AI processing providers, under data protection terms at least as protective as our own, as described in our Data Processing Addendum. Our AI sub-processors process Customer Content under zero data retention terms and may not use it to train their models. Account and Usage Data may also be shared with vendors who assist with payment processing, analytics, customer support, or marketing on our behalf.
Affiliates and Partners: With our affiliates or trusted business partners in connection with joint services, mergers, acquisitions, or other business transactions. Customer Content is not shared with affiliates or partners, except as part of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, in which case it remains subject to the commitments in this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service.
Legal and Safety Obligations: With law enforcement, government authorities, or other relevant third parties as required by law, court order, legal process, or to protect the rights, safety, and property of Upfirst, our users, or the public. If we receive a subpoena, court order, or other legal process seeking Customer Content, we will notify the customer as described in Section 3.4 of our Data Processing Addendum, unless the law prohibits us from doing so.
With Your Consent: For any other purpose disclosed to you at the time we collect your information, provided we have your consent.
SMS Consent Protection
‍ All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.
4. Data Security
We protect information with administrative, technical, and physical safeguards, including encryption in transit and at rest, and access to Customer Content limited to personnel who need it to provide the Service. No security measures are completely infallible, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. If we become aware of a security incident affecting Customer Content, we will notify the affected customer within 72 hours, as described in our Terms of Service and Data Processing Addendum.
5. Data Retention
We retain Customer Content while your account is active so it remains available in your dashboard. You can export call transcripts and download call recordings at any time. After you cancel, you have 90 days to export your Customer Content, and it remains available if you resubscribe during that period. Following a period of no less than 90 days from cancellation, Customer Content is permanently deleted from the Service. You may request earlier deletion at any time by emailing privacy@upfirst.ai. We retain account and billing information as long as needed to comply with legal, tax, and accounting obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
6. Your Rights and Choices
Access and Update: You may access and update your account information at any time through the Service.
Export and Deletion: You can export call transcripts and download call recordings at any time through the Service. To request deletion of your Customer Content or account, email privacy@upfirst.ai.
Opt-Out of Marketing: You can opt out of promotional communications by following the unsubscribe instructions in our messages or contacting us at legal@upfirst.ai .
Cookies and Tracking: You can adjust your browser settings to manage cookies. Disabling cookies may affect some functionalities of the Service.
7. International Data Transfers
Upfirst stores Customer Content in the United States. The Service is operated from the United States, so if you use it from another country, your information will be transferred to the United States. Some of our service providers may process information outside the United States, under data protection terms consistent with this Privacy Policy.
8. Children’s Privacy
The Service is not intended for individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we learn that we have inadvertently collected information from a minor, we will delete it promptly.
9. Changes to this Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the revised Privacy Policy and update the “Effective Date.” Your continued use of the Service after the changes become effective indicates your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.
10. Contact Us
If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
Upfirst Inc.

FAQs
Do you count spam toward my total calls? No. We use AI to automatically detect and block spam, telemarketing, and other robocalls, so they don't count against your plan. We also don't bill for calls under 15 seconds or calls where the caller never speaks, so junk calls like pocket dials don't cost you anything. Both types of calls are labeled in your call log, so you can easily see which calls you were billed for and which you weren't.
Can I keep my current phone number? Yes. Every Upfirst plan comes with a phone number, and you can forward calls from your cell phone, landline, or VoIP number to your Upfirst line with no porting required. If you'd rather port your number, we'll help you do it at no extra charge.
What does the free trial include? Full access to every feature for 14 days or 100 calls, whichever comes first, plus 25 text messages. There's no commitment. We don't ask for a credit card, so you're never billed automatically when your trial ends.
Do I have to sign a contract? No. You can cancel, upgrade, or downgrade anytime, no questions asked. If you pay annually, you get 20% off.
How does the setup process work? When you sign up, enter your website and we'll use it as a starting point to train your receptionist. From there, you can customize the questions it asks, add answers to your frequently asked questions, and connect it to your calendar or CRM. We also offer a free 30-minute onboarding call with one of our voice AI experts to help you get the most out of your 14-day free trial, plus onboarding support via chat. If you have more complex needs, our Scale and Enterprise plans include white-glove onboarding. Over a few implementation calls, our team sets everything up for you, including your integrations.
Does Upfirst integrate with my CRM? Yes. On every plan, you can connect Upfirst to any CRM with an API, so your agent can look up or update records during or after a call. You can also connect thousands of apps through Zapier. On the Scale plan, our team sets up your integrations for you.
Does Upfirst integrate with my calendar? Yes. Upfirst books appointments directly into Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Square, and Clio Manage.
Can I have more than one AI agent with Upfirst? Yes. If you have more than one business, or one business with multiple locations, you can easily add more agents. Each additional agent is $9.95 per month. You can share training between agents or keep certain knowledge separate.
Do you offer customer support? Yes. Real humans are available Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time. On weekends, our friendly AI assistant is available to help. Pro and Scale plans also get access to a priority support queue.
